title: Pure Mermail
summary: Mermail, Atlantean and Abyss- cards with generic staples; the 2024 and 2025 support treats them as one family. The page's combo lines add Fishborg, Marincess, Deep Sea and Coelacanth cards, so they use cards this list leaves out. Abyssrhine and Shadow Squad turn WATER discards into Level 7s from the Deck, and Poseidra, the Storming Atlantean, the newest Main Deck card, summons itself and bounces a card. The Level 7s become Abyssgaios, Poseidra Abyss or Abysstrite, the Atlantean Spirit. Several effects lock the Extra Deck to WATER, so every Extra Deck card is WATER.

allow.Virtue Stream: The Trap from the 2024 Mermail set; LeVirtue Dragon searches it.
